body.statement:
Suppose \(p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})\) and \(\operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\).  Then every \(u\in\mathbb R^d\) has a compatible lift \(p_0+tBu\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) for all sufficiently small positive \(t\), admits a feasible optimal symbolic completion in \(\mathcal B_0\), and belongs to at least one completed semantic cell.  Hence
\[
 \bigcup_{v\in V}D_v^0=\mathbb R^d.
\]
Equality signs belong to all incident completions.  More generally, use the causally compatible offset space
\[
 \mathcal K_0=\{A_\Psi z:z\in\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\}.
\]
If \(c_n\to c\in\mathcal K_0\), the compact-uniform moving remainders vanish, and a compact \(C\) has distance at least \(\tau>0\) from every hyperplane \(c_j+a_j'u=0\), then the lawful multinomial label on \(C\) eventually equals the label generated by \(D_v^0(c)\).  At \(c=0\) this is the label fan of \(\mathfrak G_0\).  If there are no active cuts, there is one retained global semantic label and the honest diameter minimax value is zero.
body.justification: The corrected proposition derives legal symbolic completions from the compatible observed-law polytope and a proved relative-interior lift.
body.gap: Its proof can be attached after the new domain assumptions and structured definitions are adjudicated; no ambient-simplex neighborhood is used.
body.consumer: It validates the global cover condition for the zero-offset Gaussian experiment and the causal moving-offset space.

obligation.what_is_open: After adjudication of the proposed local compatible-law neighborhood, prove that every tangent direction admits a legal optimal symbolic completion and hence a semantic cell.
obligation.obstruction: Multinomial interiority concerns only observed cell probabilities. Even \(\mathcal F(p_0)\ne\varnothing\) permits \(p_0\) to lie on the boundary of the observable causal model, where some \(Bu\) directions have no feasible endpoint program.
obligation.attempted: Weak-sign and equality-face completion proves the cover conditional on existence of one feasible optimal completion at each direction. The proposed relative-interior condition is a model-level, noncircular way to obtain it.
obligation.partial_result: Whenever a feasible optimal symbolic completion exists at \(u\), assigning every active cut its weak sign and assigning equality to all incident sides places \(u\) in a completed cell and hence in some \(D_v^0\).  The proposed local relative-interior condition for the compatible observed-law set yields feasible nearby endpoint programs along every direction and is the noncircular route to such a completion.  Without that condition, \(\mathcal F(p_0)\ne\varnothing\) alone need not make an arbitrary direction \(Bu\) tangent to the observable causal model.
